title: Toward Independent Imani Growth: Accompanying Your Young Adult at Life’s Threshold (16-18 Years)
description: A pathway to help parents guide their child from the iman they received at home to an iman they deepen through understanding and conviction, while preparing for marriage and upholding `iffah (chastity) through open dialogue. It focuses on crafting a life mission that connects ambition with purpose, and independence with decision-making and responsibility—before leaving home.

primary_reference.info: Tarbiyat al-Awlad fi al-Islam (Raising Children in Islam) by Abdullah Nasih Ulwan + Manhaj al-Tarbiyah al-Nabawiyyah lil-Tifl (The Prophetic Method of Raising the Child) by Muhammad Nur Suwayd

review_defects.why: The Arabic specifies 'ابنهم' (their son), while the English uses the gender-neutral 'child', which loses the specific reference to a male child.
The backtick character before 'iffah' is a non-standard transliteration marker for the Arabic letter ʿayn; it should use the standard ʿ symbol.
